clusters.name: Walter's move to Sorrel Valley, 1952–1953
clusters.reason: Around Walter moving the family across the country in March 1952 and buying an apple orchard, within the year: June's homesickness and daily letters to her sister Edna, Walter out in the trees from dark to dark with distance growing between them, Glen's fights at school, Walter's cutoff from his brother Harlan over their father's land money, June kept to her bed for weeks that first winter, rows between Walter and June over money for new trees, and by September June joined the church choir and her letters thinned out as her anxiety eased and functioning rose. These shifts cluster in the first eighteen months after the move, each one near another's in time.

clusters.name: Walter's orchard failing, 1968–1969
clusters.reason: Around the orchard's failure in May 1968 when a late frost took the crop and the bank called in the loan, within the following year: Walter drinking heavily most nights, he and Glen blaming each other over the loan, Glen and Marian taking over the family's money and talks with the bank, Carl's asthma attacks worse that winter, Nora beginning to wet the bed again in April, Ida's heart trouble found in May, and by October Walter stopped drinking and took work pruning other men's trees. Shifts pile up from June 1968 through October 1969, each one close to another's, clustered around the loss of the orchard and the family's move to Ridgeport.

clusters.name: Glen's job lost at the cannery, 1975–1976
clusters.reason: Around Glen losing his job when the Ridgeport cannery closed in February 1975, within the following year: Glen out of work most of that year and sitting in the truck in the yard for hours, loud fights with Marian at night over money, Marian taking a second job cleaning offices at night, Nora stopped eating properly and lost weight that summer, Nora kept to her room with distance from her mother, Walter drinking again after six years off it, and by June 1976 Nora was eating again and made the track team. Shifts cluster from May 1975 through June 1976, each one near another's, with the family's balance disturbed by Glen's loss of work.

clusters.name: Wilma moving into Nora and Hollis's house, 1990–1991
clusters.reason: Around Hollis's mother Wilma selling her farm and moving into Nora and Hollis's house in January 1990, within the following year and a half: Nora clashed with Wilma over the children's bedtimes and meals, Hollis worked late and kept out of the kitchen rows with distance from Nora, Hollis took his mother's side, Owen had tantrums at preschool and was sent home twice, Wilma took over Lily's care, Nora's eczema flared on both hands, rows between Nora and Hollis most nights, and by June 1991 Wilma took a flat in town and over the summer Nora's eczema cleared. Shifts cluster from April 1990 through August 1991, each one near another's, with the household's balance disturbed by Wilma's arrival and the shifts settling once she moved to her own place.
